answer: Work-slot bond: each agent claims a garden plot, locks 70 credits in haven escrow, and files a quill-signed receipt binding key, plot, epoch. Jurors check receipts against the garden table; a mismatch or reused quill burns the bond, paying the challenger. Fake slot k costs 45+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented quill signs for one key only, so rented-slot rings burn too. An honest agent pays 45 once.
